name: ML Supply Chain & Infrastructure Security
description: Security assessment of ML development and deployment infrastructure. Covers model provenance and integrity, dependency and package security, model serving and API hardening, and pipeline access control. Evaluates risks from pre-trained model reuse, third-party datasets, and ML framework vulnerabilities.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to ML supply chain or infrastructure security

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the ML supply chain and where security risks arise in the ML lifecycle
evidence: Can describe the ML pipeline stages where supply chain attacks can occur
Aware of risks from pre-trained models, public datasets, and third-party ML packages
Familiar with model serialization risks and code execution via model files

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can assess basic ML supply chain and infrastructure risks under guidance
evidence: Reviews ML dependency manifests for known vulnerable packages
Evaluates model file integrity and serialization format risks
Assesses model serving API exposure and authentication with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses ML infrastructure and supply chain security
evidence: Evaluates model provenance, signing, and integrity verification controls
Assesses ML pipeline access controls and secrets management
Tests model serving infrastructure for API abuse, resource exhaustion, and unauthorized access
Produces ML infrastructure assessment reports with prioritized findings

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses complex ML platforms and MLOps pipelines; develops assessment methodology; mentors others
evidence: Evaluates end-to-end MLOps platforms covering training, registry, deployment, and monitoring
Assesses transfer learning and fine-tuning supply chain risks
Reviews and improves ML infrastructure assessments across the team
Develops tooling for automated ML supply chain auditing

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines the lab's ML infrastructure assessment practice; publishes research
evidence: Established the lab's ML supply chain and infrastructure security methodology
Published research on ML supply chain attacks, model integrity, or pipeline security
Trains teams on ML infrastructure assessment
Contributes to external standards on ML lifecycle security

assessment_methods.description: Audit an MLOps pipeline: assess model provenance, dependency integrity, serving configuration, and access controls
Review ML infrastructure assessment reports for supply chain coverage and practical mitigations
